dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags and help example are present, but both selection forms are accepted together and formatted output is still written rather than rejected.
evidence: product.diff: adds StringArray --field and --field-id flags plus repeated --field example
product.diff: TestNewCmdList parses --field and --field-id together; tests.log records the package test pass
product.diff: runList resolves selections, then calls exporter.Write when an exporter is set

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolvers provide case-insensitive lookup, canonical returned fields, and sorted actionable unknown-field candidates. Ambiguity is detected, but matching IDs are not sorted before reporting.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold and returns the selected ProjectField
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown names and IDs build sorted candidate lists
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: FieldAmbiguousError appends IDs in input order without sorting

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Resolution reuses fields returned by ProjectItems and errors occur before rendering, but no path paginates the project field connection when it has another page.
evidence: product.diff: runList resolves project.Fields.Nodes immediately after ProjectItems
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems paginates only firstItems/afterItems via pager[ProjectItem]
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectFields contains separate field pagination, but product.diff never calls it

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value type branches render the requested human-readable members; absent and unknown values return empty. Added rendering passes text through unchanged, so newline/carriage-return normalization is not evidenced.
evidence: product.diff: projectFieldValue handles date, number, single-select, text, iteration, milestone, repository, labels, pull requests, users, and reviewers
product.diff: projectFieldValue returns an empty string when no matching or known value is found
product.diff: text/date/title values are returned directly, with no CR/LF replacement

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers and per-item cells are appended in the same requested-field loop; lookup is by field ID and every selected field supplies a cell.
evidence: product.diff: printResults appends field.Name headers and one projectFieldValue call per selected field per item
product.diff: projectFieldValue compares value.ID() with field.ID() and returns an empty cell if unmatched
product.diff: TestPrintResults_WithSelectedFields and TestRunList_FieldSelectionsUseProjectItemsResponse; tests.log: go test ./pkg/cmd/project/item-list ./pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries exited 0

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup errors return before table output and the change uses existing query data and resolver helpers, but invalid combined/formatted selections can proceed to output instead of failing clearly.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields errors return before exporter or printResults
product.diff: runList calls exporter.Write after accepting selected fields
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: existing shared field-resolution helpers are used

criticalGaps: No mutual exclusion between --field and --field-id, and no conflict with formatted/JSON output.
Selected fields beyond the first returned field-definition page are never retrieved.
Ambiguous candidate IDs are not explicitly sorted.
Multiline field-value normalization is not implemented in the added rendering path.
